slices.focus: Nadia establishes a monthly volunteer table at the district family welcome center for pre-checking school forms.
slices.summary: Ahead of the summer arrivals and school registration crunch, Nadia secures a recurring monthly table at the district family welcome center where volunteers pre-check school forms and flag interpreter needs before families reach the main desk. She creates a stripped-down checklist (missing signatures, immunizations, address questions, preferred language). She plans to tighten the language notes section, give volunteers a clear opening script, and keep a short running log of saves from the first rounds.
open_loops: Tighten interpreter language notes on volunteer sheet
Give volunteers a clearer opening script
Keep short running log of specific saves and examples
Define success narrowly for month one (fewer line-side corrections, fewer interpreter scrambles)
